verdict.rationale: Mercury says Books automatically categorizes transactions across banking, cards, and invoicing, including linked external accounts and third-party platforms like Stripe, PayPal, and Gusto. It also says GL codes are assigned 'based on your categorization history and AI-driven suggestions', with categorization rules available. That history-based assignment implies learning from your past choices, and Mercury itself frames the output as a starting point for review rather than autopilot. Missing for 10: explicit documentation that corrections to suggestions feed back into future categorization; confirmation that history-based learning applies to imported external transactions (the GL-history claim comes from the Mercury-transaction integration context); independent or hands-on corroboration.
